0.100: table cell: the spectra tables show values with %.4g (0.1), not Qt's fixed three decimals
3: numeral of the Qt welcome text's ordered list (and a row header): the welcome page lists the steps without numerals; the tables number their rows in a # column
4: numeral of the Qt welcome text's ordered list: see 3
5: numeral of the Qt welcome text's ordered list: see 3
6: numeral of the Qt welcome text's ordered list: see 3
?: the Qt '?' help button is the Help button
a: caption of the Qt component-add spin box: the native add row is labelled Amplitude
l: caption of the Qt lifetime-add spin box: the native add row is labelled Lifetime (ns)
ρ: caption of the Qt rotation-add spin box: the native add row is labelled Correlation time (ns)
ρ(ns): Qt rotation column header: the native column is Correlation time (ns)
bgfrom: Qt 'BG from' caption: the native fields are labelled Background from / Background to (one per line)
to: Qt 'to' caption between the two background spin boxes: see Background to
loadspectrum: Qt 'Load spectrum': the native button is Load spectra (it loads both)
savespectrum: Qt 'Save spectrum': the native button is Save spectra (it saves both)
next›: Qt 'Next >': the native button is Next
‹back: Qt '< Back': the native button is Back
